scope: Exact minimum closed-integer positive square energy among all legal trees of depth at most four on the original eleven anchors. Four minimizers are certified; author computation, no independent Review.
arithmetic: Exact fractions for inputs and continuous comparisons; outward integer interval chord and energy computations at scale 10^60; no floating pass/fail decisions.

continuous_minimizer_envelope_identity.scope: Continuous entire closed interval; all four envelopes equal max(F,P_4096).

continuous_overrun_objective_comparison.scope: Continuous supremum of E_T-max(J,F), with every original fine node and every midpoint residual zero included; true-input perturbation paid by 2*max node radius.
continuous_overrun_objective_comparison.shared_edge_unique_maximizer: The actual F/J crossing between1536 and2048; two residual signs and the strict line/F slope difference were certified.
